categories.name: Payments / L402
categories.description: Make APIs payable, discoverable, and consumable by people and agents. Reach Lightning wallets you do not hold, and mint or carry bearer notes.

repos.name: toll-booth
repos.description: Any API becomes a Lightning toll booth in one line. L402 middleware for Express, Hono, Deno, Bun, and Workers. Payment rails hardened by a full security review in v5.

repos.name: toll-booth-rs
repos.description: L402 payment middleware for Rust. Gates any HTTP API behind Lightning payments, with trusted-proxy IP handling and zeroised key material.

repos.name: 402-announce
repos.description: Announce HTTP 402 services on Nostr for decentralised discovery using kind 31402.

repos.name: 402-mcp
repos.description: MCP client for AI agents to discover, pay for, and consume L402 and x402 APIs.

repos.name: 402-pub
repos.description: Live directory at 402.pub for Lightning-paid APIs.

repos.name: toll-booth-announce
repos.description: Bridge between toll-booth and 402-announce for Nostr service announcements.

repos.name: toll-booth-dvm
repos.description: Expose any toll-booth-gated API as a NIP-90 Data Vending Machine on Nostr. Results are NIP-44-encrypted to the requester; upstream access is fail-closed behind an explicit whitelist.

repos.name: toll-booth-mcp
repos.description: MCP server with read-only analytics and widget UIs for toll-booth deployments. Credential-class fields are redacted before anything reaches the LLM context.

repos.name: 402-indexer
repos.description: Nostr-native crawler that discovers L402 and x402 paid APIs.

repos.name: payment-methods
repos.description: Specifications for HTTP Payment Authentication methods (Lightning, Cashu, Session).

repos.name: aperture-phoenixd
repos.description: Phoenixd backend for Aperture. No LND required.

repos.name: aperture-announce
repos.description: Announce Aperture L402 services on Nostr for decentralised discovery.

repos.name: farrier-kit
repos.description: Lightning payment primitives that work anywhere: BOLT-11 decoding, preimage verification, LNURL-pay resolution. Browser and Node from one codebase, with language-neutral conformance vectors.

repos.name: nwc-kit
repos.description: Small NIP-47 wallet client with NIP-44 v2, signed capability discovery, authenticated responses, and bounded requests.

repos.name: nwc-lnd-bridge
repos.description: Minimal NIP-47 wallet service in front of an LND node. Invoice-only by default, with the method allowlist enforced before a request reaches LND, so the connection URI cannot spend.

repos.name: moneyer
repos.description: LNURLcash (LUD-25) mint that strikes Lightning bearer notes. Independent implementation with cln and lnd funding sources, SQLite, a crash-safe melt discipline, and the public conformance grader in its own test suite.

repos.name: notecase
repos.description: LNURLcash (LUD-25) wallet for Lightning bearer notes: receive, hold, split, merge, send and melt notes whose secret is the money. Built so no crash, timeout or lying mint can lose one; CLI and web surface, NWC-assisted minting and melting.

categories.name: Spatial / Meeting
categories.description: Build location-aware workflows and fair meeting-point tools.

repos.name: geohash-kit
repos.description: Zero-dependency geohash toolkit for encoding, decoding, polygon coverage, and Nostr location filters.

repos.name: rendezvous-kit
repos.description: Find fair meeting points for N participants with isochrone intersection, venue search, and fairness scoring.

repos.name: rendezvous-mcp
repos.description: MCP server for AI-driven fair meeting-point discovery.

repos.name: flock-kit
repos.description: Framework-free location-safety and trusted-circle primitives: the honest radar guidance core, heading engine, cue grammar, and consented live-session rules.

repos.name: capacitor-mesh-ble
repos.description: Configurable Bluetooth LE mesh transport for Capacitor apps — discovery, GATT, chunking, dedup, and multi-hop relay over an encrypted phone-to-phone mesh.

categories.name: Identity / Access
categories.description: Hardware-backed Nostr signing, deterministic identities, spoken verification, encrypted access control, decentralised identity verification, and family wardship on your own keys.

repos.name: nsec-tree
repos.description: Deterministic Nostr sub-identity derivation. One master secret, unlimited unlinkable identities.

repos.name: heartwood
repos.description: Keyless NIP-46 bridge daemon for hardware Nostr signers (ESP32 or Ledger). Keys live on the device and never touch the networked computer.

repos.name: heartwood-esp32
repos.description: nsec-tree signing token for Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3/V4 (ESP32-S3). On-device button approval, up to 8 master identities.

repos.name: heartwood-ledger
repos.description: Heartwood signer as a Ledger embedded app. NIP-46, NIP-44, and nsec-tree personas on the secure element — emulator-proven prototype.

repos.name: bark
repos.description: NIP-07 browser extension backed by NIP-46 remote signing. No user keys stored; derived personas with Heartwood.

repos.name: cambium
repos.description: Android NIP-55 signer that holds no keys. Every request is proxied to a Heartwood hardware signer over NIP-46.

repos.name: sapwood
repos.description: Browser-based device manager for Heartwood. Web Serial and HTTP bridge, firmware updates, policy management.

repos.name: nsec-tree-cli
repos.description: Offline-first CLI for nsec-tree with derivation, proofs, and Shamir recovery.

repos.name: nsec-tree-py
repos.description: Python port of nsec-tree. Conformant deterministic sub-identity derivation, interop-tested against the TypeScript implementation.

repos.name: spoken-token
repos.description: Derive time-rotating, human-speakable verification tokens from a shared secret.

repos.name: canary-kit
repos.description: Deepfake-proof identity verification with per-member spoken words, silent duress detection, encrypted group sync.

repos.name: signet
repos.description: Decentralised identity verification for Nostr. 4 verification tiers, ZKP age proofs, Signet Score (0-200).

repos.name: signet-credentials
repos.description: Publish, fetch, parse, and validate Signet credential events on Nostr.

repos.name: signet-login
repos.description: Drop-in login SDK for Nostr-aware websites with NIP-07, bunker URI, and Signet redirect/QR flows.

repos.name: signet-protocol-rs
repos.description: Rust implementation of the Signet identity protocol on Nostr.

repos.name: signet-verify
repos.description: Drop-in age verification SDK for websites. One script tag, one function call.

repos.name: dominion
repos.description: Epoch-based encrypted access control. HKDF content keys, AES-256-GCM, Shamir secret sharing, tiered audiences.

repos.name: covey-kit
repos.description: Private circle primitives for Nostr: derived per-circle keys, roles, word-code invites, personal inboxes, and convergent membership state.

repos.name: roost-kit
repos.description: Nostr transport for private circles: NIP-59 gift wraps, relay fan-out, rotating inboxes, and a pre-signed offline outbox.

repos.name: keystore-kit
repos.description: Browser key-at-rest — protect a secret with a PIN, WebAuthn-PRF, or a grace window; pluggable storage and burn. Curve-agnostic, pure Web Crypto, zero runtime deps.

repos.name: kintrinsic
repos.description: Libre, self-hosted digital wardship. A guardian grants scoped, revocable screen-time, app, content and comms clauses to a child’s devices, signed with the family’s own keys and enforced on-device: an Android Device Owner ward app, a Linux warden, a guardian app and a Nostr wire contract, with no platform account in the middle.

categories.name: Storage / Data
categories.description: Keep your files alive across machines you control: encrypted, content-addressed Blossom storage that is reachable without depending on one host.

repos.name: wildbloom
repos.description: Local-first encrypted publishing over Nostr and Blossom: files that outlive their host. Publishes to standard Blossom servers over HTTPS or optional Tor, with BitTorrent as an extra lane.

repos.name: wildbloom-node
repos.description: Self-hosted Blossom storage node. Owner, friend and guest retention tiers over one deduplicated store; Tor is optional or run behind your own HTTPS; verified BUD-04 mirror and exact-hash repair.

repos.name: shelter-kit
repos.description: Transport-neutral Blossom storage core in Rust: unbound router, BUD authorisation, content-addressed streaming store, owner/friend/guest retention and verified mirror-and-repair. A library, not a daemon.

repos.name: forgesworn-link
repos.description: Wide-area transport lane for ForgeSworn storage: two authorised nodes find a route, try a direct QUIC path and fall back to an opaque relay, on standard Rust crates and nobody’s endpoint IDs. The native lane a Tor-less Wildbloom node uses to mirror and repair between machines.

categories.name: Live / Real-time
categories.description: Video rooms and live streams whose signalling rides Nostr relays, with media device to device and no operator in the middle.

repos.name: kithmoot
repos.description: Multi-device conference rooms over Nostr: a town hall nobody owns. A room is a secret held by whoever has the link, and a person rather than a device is the unit that joins, so a phone and a laptop appear as one participant. Mesh WebRTC, Kindred-gated access tiers, and the relays, STUN and TURN the room names itself.

repos.name: kithmoot-android
repos.description: Native Kotlin implementation of the KithMoot protocol: the second, independent implementation, written against the published interop vectors, and the proof that the protocol is infrastructure rather than a product.

repos.name: relayswarm
repos.description: Peer-assisted HLS live-stream distribution with WebRTC signalling over Nostr relays instead of a dedicated tracker, so there is no signalling service for anyone to seize. Segments verified by hash, plain HLS as the floor.

repos.name: relayswarm-kit
repos.description: Swift implementation of RelaySwarm signalling for macOS and iOS: presence and NIP-44-encrypted SDP exchange over Nostr relays, a minimal Nostr client, throwaway per-session keys, and WebRTC data channels via libdatachannel.

repos.name: nostr-veil

repos.name: nostr-attestations

repos.name: nostr-anon-vote
